propositions: Comment identity must be based on a persistent HLC-timestamp to Jira-comment-ID map rather than normalized body text to prevent collisions when identical comment bodies are synced multiple times

Returned Jira comment IDs from add_comment operations must be captured at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one via _apply_outbound_update) and persisted immediately via write-ahead save for crash durability
Outbound comment bodies must render through the real RichTextCodec (AdfCodec for Cloud, WikiTextCodec for DC) with fit-then-encode ordering, with ADF JSON serialization sent via acli --body parameter

Comment sync must remain strictly append-only: new comments mirror once each direction via distinct identity stores (jira_comment_id for inbound, map for outbound), and edits or deletes are never synced

The _resolve_codec injection in _diff_comments must migrate from _IdentityCodec to the real codec, and inbound differ must remain unchanged using only RECONCILER_MARKER and jira_comment_id loop-breakers
